title: Detect Cycle
description: Floyd tortoise-and-hare: two pointers move at 1x and 2x speed. If they ever meet, there is a cycle. O(n) time, O(1) space.

notes: Loop condition checks BOTH fast and fast.next — fast moves 2, so both hops must be legal.
Compare with === (reference equality on the node object), not by .val.
Hash-set approach also works in O(n) time but uses O(n) space. Floyd is the canonical O(1)-space.

questions.q: Why must the loop check both `fast` AND `fast.next`?
options: fast moves two steps; both .next hops must be non-null
